title: General English - Level 02
overview: General English – Level 02 builds on beginner-level foundations and develops learners’ ability to communicate with greater independence in familiar social, travel, and workplace situations. Through structured language practice, learners extend their vocabulary, strengthen their control of essential grammar, and improve fluency and accuracy in listening, speaking, reading, and writing. The course is designed for learners progressing toward an elementary (approximately CEFR A2) level, with practical tasks that support confident everyday communication.
audience: Learners who have completed General English – Level 01 or demonstrate equivalent beginner proficiency.
Adults and young professionals seeking greater confidence in everyday English.
Employees who use simple English for routine workplace and customer interactions.
Individuals preparing to progress to intermediate English-language studies.
methodology: Interactive instructor-led lessons integrate communicative pair and group tasks, guided conversations, listening and reading activities, contextual grammar practice, pronunciation coaching, and short writing assignments. Learners apply language in realistic situations such as making arrangements, explaining problems, giving directions, and discussing past experiences. Formative quizzes, role-plays, peer feedback, and end-of-course skills assessments track progress and guide targeted practice.
competencies: Communicating effectively in routine social and workplace exchanges.
Understanding the main points of clear spoken English on familiar subjects.
Using present, past, and future forms with improving grammatical accuracy.
Asking follow-up questions and sustaining short conversations.
Reading practical texts, emails, notices, and short articles for key information.
Writing coherent short messages, descriptions, and simple emails.
Applying appropriate vocabulary, pronunciation, and polite expressions in common situations.
objectives: Describe daily activities, interests, experiences, and plans using connected sentences.
Ask for and provide information, clarification, directions, and assistance.
Narrate simple past events and discuss future arrangements and intentions.
Compare people, places, products, and choices using suitable descriptive language.
Understand everyday conversations, announcements, and short spoken instructions.
Read familiar texts to identify main ideas, relevant details, and sequence.
Write short organized paragraphs, invitations, messages, and practical emails.
Participate in routine conversations with more natural rhythm, confidence, and accuracy.
